verses.english: “There are three grounds, mendicants, by which a person with faith and confidence can be known.

verses.pali: Sīlavantānaṁ dassanakāmo hoti, saddhammaṁ sotukāmo hoti, vigatamalamaccherena cetasā agāraṁ ajjhāvasati muttacāgo payatapāṇi vossaggarato yācayogo dānasaṁvibhāgarato.
verses.english: They like to see ethical people. They like to hear the true teaching. And they live at home rid of the stain of stinginess, freely generous, open-handed, loving to let go, committed to charity, loving to give and to share.

verses.pali: Imehi kho, bhikkhave, tīhi ṭhānehi saddho pasanno veditabbo.
verses.english: These are the three grounds by which a person with faith and confidence can be known.
They like to see ethical people;
they want to hear the true teaching;
they’ve driven out the stain of stinginess:
that’s who’s called an individual of faith.”
